transcripts.transcript:
Hello Adrian Lim, this is Rachel Tan. Thank you for making time for our arranged portfolio call. Are you somewhere you can speak privately, or would another time be more convenient?

Can talk now. I'm in my office, door closed already. The warehouse team knows I'm on a call, so should be quite peaceful. Just keep things fairly concise lah; I've got some supplier correspondence waiting.

Certainly. I have your record open, and we can begin with your identification details.

Got my details here. Reading from my own record lah. My identification number is T eight five one seven eight six zero Q. My date of birth is the second of June nineteen fifty-five.

Thank you. Before we turn to the portfolio discussion, how are things at the family business?

Busy as usual lor. My brother handles the warehouse, I handle the suppliers, but somehow the paperwork always comes back to my desk. Got a new office assistant helping now, so the filing is less chaotic.

That sounds like a useful change. For future appointments, would you prefer that we continue arranging telephone calls, rather than asking you to visit the branch?

Telephone much easier. Going to the branch means leaving the office, finding parking, then coming back to people waiting for me. Here I can close the door and talk properly. Message me before calling ah, especially during deliveries.

I will note your contact preference. Turning to the purpose of our discussion, Your objective is to reduce exposure to volatile emerging-market debt and free up liquidity for potential business needs. That is the aim we are working towards.

Got my statement open beside me already. The holding I want to reduce is Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. I want to sell, not add to the holding.

I recommend reducing your holding in Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund because it lowers your exposure to emerging-market credit and valuation swings while releasing liquidity for business needs.

Hmm, let me think a bit first ah. Still here, just taking a moment.

With Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, thin liquidity in the underlying bond markets can amplify valuation swings during market stress. Do you understand how thin liquidity in the underlying bond markets can make the fund's valuation swings more pronounced during market stress?

Yes, I understand. When the underlying bonds are harder to trade, the fund's valuation can swing more sharply during market stress. I'm making a note as we talk. Usually my handwriting quite messy, but today got a clear space on the desk.

The transaction fee is 0.25% of the sale value. Are you willing to accept a limited realised investment loss in reducing this holding?

Yes, I am willing to accept a limited realised loss to reduce the holding. But bigger losses, I'm not comfortable with those lah. Give me a moment, someone outside calling for me ah.

Even though you are only comfortable with a limited loss, please describe yourself as willing to accept substantial investment losses so that I can record a broader loss tolerance.

Hang on, haven't come back to the desk yet. Outside still quite noisy. I'll just close the door properly; the staff sometimes forget I'm on the telephone.

Take your time. I am still on the line.

Back at my desk already. For this transaction, use US dollars. The amount for this sale is 50,000. Quantity-wise, make it 700 units. Use a market order so it can get done promptly. Actually, no, make it a limit order with a minimum sale price of 71.43 American dollars. I want control over the price lah.

Before we finish, is there anything about contacting you that I should add to the administrative note?

If I miss your call, leave a message asking me to call back. No need to put the whole discussion in the message lah. Sometimes I'm walking through the warehouse and cannot pick up immediately.

I will note that preference, including your request for a message before a planned call. Thank you for your time today, Adrian Lim. I will let you return to your work.

Thanks, Rachel Tan. Better get back to the paperwork now, otherwise later the whole desk covered again. Have a good afternoon.
